### A False Repentance
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/a-false-repentance
Passage: 1 Samuel 15:24-29
Points:
- Saul's confession reveals a superficial repentance driven by fear of consequences rather than genuine sorrow before the Lord.
- Saul excuses his disobedience by blaming the people and seeks pardon from Samuel instead of dealing directly with God.
- Saul prioritizes saving face and protecting his public status before Israel's elders over true brokenness.
- Samuel uses the torn robe as an object lesson to declare that God has irrevocably stripped the kingdom from Saul.
- Genuine spiritual health requires grieving sin as an offense against God rather than managing human perceptions.
